rationale: Behavior checks need observable execution evidence.
Operational evidence needs a managed data lifecycle.
Workflow actions must respect authorization and ownership.
Event-driven coordination stays debuggable only with end-to-end event tracing.
Versioned snapshots need an append-only storage policy and lifecycle management.
Contracts are validated at each versioned handoff boundary.
Breaker state transitions must be recorded as operational events.
Compensating actions and irreversible steps require authorized owners.
The reference architecture centralizes coordination in an orchestrator.
Lexical retrieval configuration is versioned data-foundations state.
k1 and b choices must be tuned and requalified through evaluation evidence.
Retrieval quality is assessed through end-to-end task evaluation.
Query trajectories must be traced to separate retrieval failures from reasoning failures.
Workspace contents are retrieved data; permission filtering and authorization still apply.
